'''Joseph Schlagheck''' (also published as '''Joe Schlagheck''' and '''Joseph Schlageck''')<ref name="dt-17826">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17826 Agents in the Court], DeckTech (joe "coo" schlagheck, 26 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17826/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17826/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''coo''') posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech in July 2001. Joseph Schlagheck also played at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]] on 30 June 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS Abyssians]], according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2663">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogalood2663/ parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogaloo], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 19 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogalood2663/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
